title: The Message of Salvation to All, Israel's Refusal

questions.question: Brothers, my heart's desire and prayer to God for them is that they may be ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 10:1 (ESV): "Brothers, my heart's desire and prayer to God for them is that they may be saved."

questions.question: For I bear them witness that they have a zeal for God, but not according to ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 10:2 (ESV): "For I bear them witness that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge."

questions.question: For, being ignorant of the righteousness of God, and seeking to establish their own, they did not submit to God's righteousness. For Christ is the ____ of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
questions.explanation: Romans 10:3-4 (ESV): "...they did not submit to God's righteousness. For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes."

questions.question: For Moses writes about the righteousness that is based on the law, that the person who does the commandments shall ____ by them.
questions.explanation: Romans 10:5 (ESV): "For Moses writes about the righteousness that is based on the law, that the person who does the commandments shall live by them."

questions.question: But the righteousness based on faith says, "Do not say in your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?'" (that is, to bring Christ down) "or 'Who will descend into the ____?'" (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).
questions.explanation: Romans 10:6-7 (ESV): "But the righteousness based on faith says... 'or Who will descend into the abyss?' (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead)."

questions.question: What does it say? "The word is near you, in your mouth and in your ____"—that is, the word of faith that we proclaim.
questions.explanation: Romans 10:8 (ESV): "But what does it say? 'The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart' (that is, the word of faith that we proclaim);"

questions.question: If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 10:9 (ESV): "because, if you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved."

questions.question: For with the heart one believes and is justified, and with the mouth one confesses and is ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 10:10 (ESV): "For with the heart one believes and is justified, and with the mouth one confesses and is saved."

questions.question: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, bestowing his riches on all who ____ him.
questions.explanation: Romans 10:12 (ESV): "For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, bestowing his riches on all who call on him."

questions.question: For "everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be ____."
questions.explanation: Romans 10:13 (ESV): "For 'everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.'"

questions.question: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? And how are they to believe in him of whom they have never heard? And how are they to hear without ____?
questions.explanation: Romans 10:14 (ESV): "How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? And how are they to believe in him of whom they have never heard? And how are they to hear without someone preaching?"

questions.question: And how are they to preach unless they are sent? As it is written, "How beautiful are the feet of those who ____!"
questions.explanation: Romans 10:15 (ESV): "And how are they to preach unless they are sent? As it is written, 'How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the good news!'"

questions.question: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed what he has ____ from us?"
questions.explanation: Romans 10:16 (ESV): "But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, 'Lord, who has believed what he has heard from us?'"

questions.question: So faith comes from hearing, and hearing through the ____ of Christ.
questions.explanation: Romans 10:17 (ESV): "So faith comes from hearing, and hearing through the word of Christ."

questions.question: But of Israel he says, "All day long I have held out my hands to a ____ and contrary people."
questions.explanation: Romans 10:21 (ESV): "But of Israel he says, 'All day long I have held out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.'"

key_verse_text: because, if you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
